question: 2026年3月已確認報名的折扣後金額是多少（未扣退款）？
sql: SELECT SUM(i.seats*i.unit_price_minor-i.discount_minor) FROM bookings b JOIN booking_items i ON b.booking_id=i.booking_id WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND b.created_at_utc>=:start AND b.created_at_utc<:end

question: 2026年3月有幾筆已確認報名？

question: 2026年3月已確認報名截至2026年4月1日零時的累計成功退款是多少？

question: 2026年2月已確認報名金額是多少？
sql: SELECT SUM(i.seats*i.unit_price_minor-i.discount_minor) FROM bookings b JOIN booking_items i ON b.booking_id=i.booking_id WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND b.created_at_utc>=:start AND b.created_at_utc<:end

question: 2026年3月各中心已確認報名金額，包含無報名中心？
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT b.center_id,SUM(i.seats*i.unit_price_minor-i.discount_minor) amount FROM bookings b JOIN booking_items i ON b.booking_id=i.booking_id WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND b.created_at_utc>=:start AND b.created_at_utc<:end GROUP BY b.center_id) SELECT c.center_id,COALESCE(a.amount,0) FROM centers c LEFT JOIN a ON a.center_id=c.center_id ORDER BY c.center_id

question: 2026年3月已確認報名按課程分類拆分金額？
sql: SELECT k.category,SUM(i.seats*i.unit_price_minor-i.discount_minor) FROM bookings b JOIN booking_items i ON i.booking_id=b.booking_id JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id=i.session_id JOIN courses k ON k.course_id=s.course_id WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND b.created_at_utc>=:start AND b.created_at_utc<:end GROUP BY k.category ORDER BY k.category

question: 按台北日期列出2026年3月每日已確認報名金額（只列有資料日）？
sql: SELECT date(b.created_at_utc,'+8 hours'),SUM(i.seats*i.unit_price_minor-i.discount_minor) FROM bookings b JOIN booking_items i ON b.booking_id=i.booking_id WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND b.created_at_utc>=:start AND b.created_at_utc<:end GROUP BY date(b.created_at_utc,'+8 hours') ORDER BY 1

question: 2026年3月已確認報名金額最高的前三個課程（同額按課程ID升冪）？
sql: SELECT s.course_id,SUM(i.seats*i.unit_price_minor-i.discount_minor) amount FROM bookings b JOIN booking_items i ON i.booking_id=b.booking_id JOIN sessions s ON s.session_id=i.session_id WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND b.created_at_utc>=:start AND b.created_at_utc<:end GROUP BY s.course_id ORDER BY amount DESC,s.course_id LIMIT 3

question: 哪些已確認報名落在台北2026年3月（只驗證ID，不代表MVP提供任意明細）？
sql: SELECT booking_id FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND created_at_utc>=:start AND created_at_utc<:end ORDER BY booking_id

question: 2026年3月已確認報名金額扣除截至2026年4月1日零時的該群報名退款後是多少？

question: 2026年3月各中心的已確認報名金額目標；缺目標保留空值，不當成0？
sql: SELECT c.center_id,t.target_minor FROM centers c LEFT JOIN monthly_targets t ON t.center_id=c.center_id AND t.month_start_local='2026-03-01' AND t.metric_id='confirmed_booked_amount' ORDER BY c.center_id
